lines.en: The ‘Dog Who Threw Himself into the Flames’ ran for two nights straight with me on his back.
The constellations doggedly pursuing us threatened us repeatedly, but each time, the ‘Dog Who Threw Himself into the Flames’ literally threw himself into harm’s way to protect me.
[The Story, ‘Life-sacrificing Loyalty’, repeats its story.]
How much longer did we flee like that?
At last, dawn began to break.
[The sub-scenario ― ‘Skirmish’ has ended.]
[You have successfully protected the Story Core for the allotted time.]
One by one, the pursuing constellations stopped in the distance, and indirect messages of every kind came flying through the air.
[Several constellations who failed to catch you are disheartened.]
[The constellation, ‘Prisoner of the Golden Headband’, yawns and asks whether it is over now.]
[The constellation, ‘Demon-like Judge of Fire’, rubs her sleepy eyes and rejoices!]
[The constellation, ‘Dragon Lying Down’, nods at your stratagem.]
[Some constellations point accusing fingers at you for your cowardice.]
Let them point all they wanted. Surviving mattered more here.
Dokgak, who had been looking down at me disapprovingly, sent me my rewards as though he had no choice.
[You have received 200,000 coins as a reward.]
[You have received 2 ‘Equipment-transcendence Anvil Stones’ as a reward.]
So it was about time for equipment enhancement items to start becoming available.

Even an item rated SSS-grade in an early area was practically scrap in the middle and later scenario areas. But using a transcendence anvil stone at the right time could keep your equipment from falling behind.
That wasn’t all I had gained.
[You have acquired the Story, ‘One Who Went Against the Twelve Zodiacs’.]
It was a shame it was only Historical-grade, but the more Stories you had, the better.
After all, these little Stories came together to form your ‘overall Status’.
In particular, I would be able to put Stories gained through combat to good use with [Distorting Things as One Pleases] from now on.
[The constellations pursuing you withdraw.]

Not long after the constellations disappeared, the outlines of the ‘Yoo Joonghyuk Industrial Complex’ began to emerge in the distance. I could see citizens who had received the ‘Escape Scenario’ entering the complex in a steady stream. Fortunately, Jang Hayoung and Han Myungoh seemed to have handled things well.
I spoke to the ‘Dog Who Threw Himself into the Flames’.
“You can leave now. You don’t have to be loyal to me.”
He didn’t genuinely want to follow me anyway. We were better off parting ways here. But even after I turned away, he kept following me with little trotting steps.
Pant, pant, pant.
I frowned slightly and said,
“What? I told you to go.”
Whine······.
Moisture welled up in the large dog’s eyes.
[The constellation, ‘Demon-like Judge of Fire’, looks at the ‘Dog Who Threw Himself into the Flames’ with pity.]

The true name of the ‘Dog Who Threw Himself into the Flames’ was ‘Dog of Osu’. A dog who had soaked his own body and put out a fire on the grass to keep his drunken master from burning to death. Unfortunately, even this constellation’s true name wasn’t a name of his own.
“······You’re going to follow me?”
Whiiine!
I hesitated for a moment. Come to think of it, even if he parted ways with me, he would have trouble finding freedom.
[Some constellations eye the ‘Dog Who Threw Himself into the Flames’ hungrily.]

There were as many constellations who preyed on their fellow constellations as there were those who preyed on incarnations. If he encountered bastards with modifiers like ‘Wild Dog Hunter’ or ‘Dog Dealer of Melberg’, he would be helplessly stripped of his Stories and killed.
The Twelve Zodiacs gang was the only reason he had stayed safe this long.
“······Then come along, I guess.”
Pantpantpant!
“But make yourself a little smaller. You’re so big you’ll get in the way.”
Whiiine!
At my words, the ‘Dog Who Threw Himself into the Flames’ shrank his incarnation body. He became about the size of a golden retriever.
“Kim Dokja!”
Jang Hayoung spotted me and approached, waving from a distance.
“Hey! Are you okay? What’s with the dog?”
“Picked him up on the way. Where are the others?”
“Busy guiding the citizens.”
The ‘Dog Who Threw Himself into the Flames’ licked the back of Jang Hayoung’s hand. Jang Hayoung asked,
“What’s his name?”
I considered telling the truth, then just fudged an answer.
“Osu.”
[You have given the ‘Dog Who Threw Himself into the Flames’ a name.]
[The ‘Dog Who Threw Himself into the Flames’ is deeply moved.]
[The loyalty of the ‘Dog Who Threw Himself into the Flames’ has increased significantly!]
······If I’d known this would happen, I would have given him a better name.
Jang Hayoung, who had been examining Osu closely, brightened.
“Great. My senior sister will like him.”
For a moment, I wondered who on earth this ‘senior sister’ was.
“······You mean the Breaking the Sky Sword Master? That dog was female?”
“Did you forget that only women can learn Breaking the Sky Swordsmanship?”
Come to think of it, that was true.
That was how Breaking the Sky Swordsmanship worked.
There were so many exceptions that I’d completely forgotten.
For instance, even the person standing right in front of me······.
“······What are you staring at?”
“Nothing. It’s nothing.”
I shook my head to clear away the thoughts.
Jang Hayoung’s gender identity wasn’t the important issue right now.
Because······.
[The ‘Demon King Selection’ is about to begin!]
The ‘Demon King Selection’ would begin now.
Rrrrrumble!
“······It’s coming.”
At my words, Jang Hayoung looked up into the air too, seemingly tense.
A tremor seemed to shake the entire ‘73rd Demon Realm’. Stars of unfamiliar colors were appearing in the sky, one by one.
Constellations from all across the <Star Stream> had come to this Demon Realm to watch a major event with nothing less than a [Giant Story] at stake.
[Numerous constellations enter the channel!]
[A considerable number of demon kings enter the channel!]
Beings whose Status could be felt through their gaze alone were entering the channel.
[The constellation, ‘Queen of the Darkest Spring’, looks at you.]
[The constellation, ‘God of Wine and Ecstasy’, gazes at you.]
[The constellation, ‘Mass Production Maker’, waves at you.]
The constellations I had met along the way also appeared high in the sky.
I looked up at them, trying to quell my own nerves.
I had finally made it this far.
There were still many scenarios left, and I was still far from where they stood.
But it no longer felt impossibly distant.
At least I had reached a point where I could roughly gauge where in this mountain range those lofty constellations might stand.
[The twenty-fifth main scenario has arrived!]
Bzzzzzt!
[Part of your Status is damaged due to excessive skipping of main scenarios.]
I hadn’t properly carried out the scenarios in the twenties.
Since I had gone straight into ‘Scenario 25’ in that state, the corresponding loss of probability was unavoidable.
[The main scenario ― ‘Demon King Selection’ begins!]
<Main Scenario # 25 ― Demon King Selection>
Category: Main
Difficulty: ???
Clear Conditions: Form a team with ‘helpers’ and win in ‘Mythical Battlefield’.
Time Limit: ―
Reward: Formal succession to the demon king’s throne, ???
Failure: Death
●You may recruit ‘helpers’ for this scenario.
●A dokkaebi will provide additional explanations regarding the scenario’s proceedings.
For the first time in a while, this was a scenario with ‘death’ listed under failure.
If I lost here, I would die.
It had happened often enough along the way, so it wasn’t unfamiliar.
[This scenario will be held on a dedicated stage.]
[This scenario has a total of four principal participants.]
[Principal participants may recruit ‘helpers’ by mutual agreement.]
[You are a principal participant in this scenario.]
I sensed enormous presences to the north and west.
[Constellations affiliated with the ‘Melledon Industrial Complex’ reveal their hostility toward you.]
[Constellations affiliated with the ‘Bercan Industrial Complex’ express their antagonism toward you.]
As the constellations in the sky flickered, a dokkaebi’s voice rang out from the air.
[It has been a long wait, constellation-nims.]
Dokgak and Bihyung appeared.
[At last, the long, long-awaited ‘Demon King Selection’ begins!]
At Bihyung’s words, a hologram of a vast ‘stage’ appeared on the screen floating in the air.
[First, we would like to thank ‘Mass Production Maker’-nim for personally creating a game for this scenario!]
Exaggerated applause filled the air, and the map created by ‘Mass Production Maker’ appeared in the hologram.
[The game, ‘Mythical Battlefield’, is loading!]
The map was a vast forest bordered by enormous cliffs.
Within the forest, [Industrial Complex] emblems were engraved to the east, west, south, and north. Those probably marked the starting areas for each [Industrial Complex].
[As you may have expected, this ‘Selection’ will not be a simple exchange of blows. This ‘Selection’ will take the form of a ‘team battle’, with each industrial complex forming its own team.]
Several constellations, surprised by the dokkaebi’s words, poured out indirect messages.
Of course, I wasn’t surprised.
I already knew all about it from the original novel.
[The rules are simple. Each participant may form a ‘team’ of seven members in total, including themselves.]
[Each team member will be assigned a different ‘position’ and perform a role within the scenario through that position.]
The game resembled the so-called AOS games that had once been popular on Earth.
One tank, two melee damage dealers, another two ranged damage dealers, and one support. Plus one ‘all-rounder’.
Teams of seven competed against one another in this game ― ‘Mythical Battlefield’.
[The constellation, ‘Mass Production Maker’, smiles.]
True to that modifier, even the game was made from elements conveniently stolen from elsewhere······.
The dokkaebi continued.

[There are two ways to win. The first is to wipe out the participants on every team except your own. The second is to seize the opposing teams’ ‘sentences’. Well, you’ll learn the details by playing, so we’ll skip those······ More importantly, we have one more announcement.]
Bihyung, who had been talking at length, glanced my way.
[Originally, four teams were scheduled to participate in this ‘Selection’······ But it appears that one ‘industrial complex’ was nearly annihilated before the game even began.]
A sudden uneasiness came over me.
Bihyung continued.
[Therefore, after careful consideration of the game’s fairness, we at the <Bureau> have decided to combine the relatively disadvantaged ‘two industrial complexes’ into ‘one team’.]
Then a message rang out from the air.
[You are currently a participant representing the ‘Yoo Joonghyuk―Kim Dokja Industrial Complex’.]
This was unexpected.
I had been worried about being on a different team from Yoo Joonghyuk, but now that concern was resolved.
Bihyung had probably pulled some strings for me.
But why was it the ‘Yoo Joonghyuk―Kim Dokja Industrial Complex’?
K came before Y, so shouldn’t it obviously be called the ‘Kim Dokja―Yoo Joonghyuk Industrial Complex’? Anyway.
“Jang Hayoung, where’s Yoo Joonghyuk?”
I looked around for Yoo Joonghyuk.
But he was nowhere to be seen.
With eyes wide, Jang Hayoung asked in return.
“What are you talking about? You didn’t meet him?”
“······What do you mean, I didn’t meet him?”
“He went to look for you.”
“What?”
A bad feeling struck me.
I hurriedly used [Omniscient Reader’s Viewpoint].
[A connection to the target is currently unavailable.]
Damn it.
As I wondered how to find the bastard, something suddenly occurred to me.
Fortunately, it was midday.
[Using the item, ‘Midday Tryst’!]
‘Midday Tryst’.
It was a one-to-one chat item I had linked to him some time ago.
I didn’t know whether he was within range, but it was all I had to rely on right now.
[You have 39 unread messages.]
But what was this? Dozens of messages from him had already arrived.
I hurriedly opened the window.
The first message began like this.
Kim Dokja, ‘I’ rescued Biyoo / Sender: Yoo Joonghyuk, 47 hours 39 minutes ago
The messages continued, with short gaps between them.
But why did you suddenly disappear? / Sender: Yoo Joonghyuk, 46 hours 54 minutes ago
I have no time to indulge your childish games / Sender: Yoo Joonghyuk, 46 hours 39 minutes ago
If you don’t show yourself again, I will kill you / Sender: Yoo Joonghyuk, 45 hours 18 minutes ago
I am not joking / Sender: Yoo Joonghyuk, 44 hours 39 minutes ago
Kim Dokja / Sender: Yoo Joonghyuk, 41 hours 38 minutes ago
Dozens more messages followed.
The last message read as follows.
I’m coming / Sender: Yoo Joonghyuk, 23 hours 14 minutes ago
What? How did this bastard intend to come when he didn’t even know where I was?
Dumbfounded, I quickly sent a message.
―Idiot, hurry back! I’m at your industrial complex!
But Yoo Joonghyuk didn’t reply.
There wasn’t even a read receipt.
Instead, a scenario message came back, descending like a death sentence.
[Please recruit ‘helpers’ within 10 minutes.]
[You may recruit a total of 6 ‘helpers’.]
All I could still see were two dogs, one human of ambiguous gender, and someone trembling at the prospect that I might pick him······ suffering from postpartum depression······ Damn it.
Forget putting together a fighting force. With this lineup, I’d be lucky just to fill all seven slots.
I sighed and spoke.
“······I’ll select my helpers.”

Even if I included the two dogs, Jang Hayoung, and, as a tremendous concession, Han Myungoh, I still needed two more people. Even if I left one spot open in case Yoo Joonghyuk came, I would have to recruit someone else for the last spot. I looked up at the sky.
[All constellations in the channel listen to your words.]
It was time to put my connections to the test.
Just as I was about to address the constellations, a terrified Han Myungoh shot his hand up.
“L-leave me out! Honestly, I don’t think I’d be much help.”
His fear was understandable.
The participants and helpers on the other side were all at least on par with Historical-grade constellations.
A fighting force far beyond anything Mino Soft’s department head, who had landed the job through connections, could hope to contend with.
I firmly gripped Han Myungoh’s trembling shoulder and said,
“Just help us fill the roster. You won’t actually die even if you die in there. Just grit your teeth and play one match.”
We had ‘three’ chances in ‘Mythical Battlefield’.
Even if we lost this match, we could make up for it in the next one and the one after that.
“B-but the pain will still be real!”
“I suppose it will.”
“Then no! I won’t do it······!”
“Thank you, Department Head-nim.”
[You have acquired the helper, ‘Demon Earl Han Myungoh’.]
[Number of helpers available for recruitment: 5]

It would have been nice to find a substitute, but there was no one suitable. I could have chosen Mark or Aileen, but honestly, they were a grade below Han Myungoh, who was at the level of a demon earl.
“Obviously, I’m in.”
As if waiting for this, Jang Hayoung thumped their two small fists together.
[You have acquired the helper, ‘Dimensional Mover Jang Hayoung’.]
[Number of helpers available for recruitment: 4]
How strong was Jang Hayoung now?
I had heard that Jang Hayoung had placed third in the martial arts tournament······.
But since I hadn’t been there, I couldn’t get an accurate sense of it. No Jang Hayoung in any round had inherited the ‘Breaking the Sky Sword Saint’s’ martial arts at this point.
I turned toward the Breaking the Sky Sword Saint’s other disciple.
“Breaking the Sky Sword Master.”
Woof!
The answer was succinct.
[You have acquired the helper, ‘Dog That Recites Poetry, Breaking the Sky Sword Master’.]
[Number of helpers available for recruitment: 3]
Aside from me and Yoo Joonghyuk, the transcendent dog, the Breaking the Sky Sword Master, was someone who could ‘definitely’ hold her own against Historical-grade constellations.
She would surely be a great help in this fight.
For some reason, though, the Breaking the Sky Sword Master looked distinctly unhappy.
Grrr! Woof!
The fiercely barking Breaking the Sky Sword Master was looking at a grubby dog. I understood what she meant.
“Yes. He’s our new companion.”
Woofwoofwoof!
“There’s nothing we can do about it, even if you don’t like him.”
Osu, who had been watching her warily, sidled up and slipped his head toward the Breaking the Sky Sword Master’s backside, sniffing. Her eyes blazed, and she smacked him over the head with a forepaw.
Yelp!
He wasn’t very reassuring, but I had to include him as a companion for lack of a better option.
He was still a Historical-grade constellation, so surely he’d be better than Han Myungoh.
[You have acquired the helper, ‘Dog Who Threw Himself into the Flames, Osu’.]
[Number of helpers available for recruitment: 2]
One of the two remaining spots belonged to Yoo Joonghyuk.
[You have registered the helper, ‘Supreme King Yoo Joonghyuk’.]
[This individual is not currently nearby.]
[If this individual accepts your offer, he will be automatically summoned to the battlefield.]
[You have 5 minutes remaining.]
Now there was only one spot left.
[The constellation, ‘Demon King of Salvation’, looks at the constellations.]
I could feel the constellations’ eyes on me.
Well, shall we take volunteers?
“Would anyone like to volunteer as a helper?”
Honestly, I thought there would be at least some volunteers.
The constellations in this channel were the ones who had followed my story this far.
If two or more volunteered, I might even be able to replace Han Myungoh.
But.
[The constellation, ‘Queen of the Darkest Spring’, gives an inscrutable smile.]
[The constellation, ‘Bald General of Justice’, diligently polishes his head.]
[The constellation, ‘Mass Production Maker’, complains of back pain.]
······Damn it.
[Numerous constellations turn their heads to avoid your gaze.]
I glared up at the sky for a moment, displeased.

Persephone and Mass Production Maker were on a different level from the players on this stage, so I could leave them out of it. But the other Historical-grade constellations could have volunteered······.
I sighed and turned to Jang Hayoung.
“Jang Hayoung, did you contact the constellations I mentioned?”
In preparation for a day like this, I had already asked Jang Hayoung to try making contact with several constellations.
“What did the Maritime War God say?”
“He said, ‘I’ll give it careful thought.’”
I frowned.
How long was he planning to keep thinking?
Even if he was worried about probability, I’d gone so far as to set the stage for him······.
Was he uncomfortable with making enemies of the other nebulas after all?
[The constellation, ‘Bald General of Justice’, puts down the towel he was using to polish his head.]
My original plan had been to bring in Namgung Minyoung, the Breaking the Sky Sword Saint, and Kyrgios Rodgraim, The Paradox Baekchung, for the remaining spots.
But those two were in Murim right now.
“What about Goryeo’s First Sword?”
“No answer at all from that one.”
By this point, I was even starting to feel a little betrayed.
[The constellation, ‘Bald General of Justice’, adopts a solemn expression and tightly ties the towel he was using to polish his head around his forehead.]
There was no helping it.
If this was how things stood, I had to choose the next-best option.
[The constellation, ‘Bald General of Justice’, nods and looks at you.]
“Asmodeus. Didn’t you say you’d help?”
Bzzzt!
At the mention of his true name, an ominous black star in a corner of the sky stirred.
[The demon king, ‘Devil of Lust and Wrath’, looks at you.]
[The demon king, ‘Devil of Lust and Wrath’, says he will help starting with the third match.]
······Starting with the third match?
[The demon king, ‘Devil of Lust and Wrath’, wishes to test whether you are worthy of his help.]
I bit my lip.
So this damned demon king was sizing things up······.
When I wasn’t even sure we could make it to the third match.
The one consolation was that no demon kings’ names had appeared among the other side’s ‘helpers’ yet.
[The ‘Melledon Industrial Complex’ has designated the constellation, ‘Founder of Humanity’, as a helper.]
[The ‘Bercan Industrial Complex’ has designated the constellation, ‘Last Pharaoh’, as a helper.]
[The ‘Melledon Industrial Complex’ has designated the constellation, ‘The One Who Stabbed His Own Eyes’, as a helper.]
[The ‘Melledon Industrial Complex’ has designated the constellation, ‘General of Vanara’, as a helper.]
They might not be demon kings, but every one of those constellations had a terrifying modifier.
Some had even reached Narrative-grade.
Rrrrrumble······.
I could feel on my skin the constellations’ desire to tear, rip, chew, and savor this ‘scenario’ as soon as possible.
Now I had to clutch at any straw I could.
“Uriel.”
[The nebula, ‘Eden’, is troubled by your offer.]
[The Demon Realm’s demon kings become acutely alert to the movements of the nebula, ‘Eden’.]
······I’d forgotten that this was the ‘Demon Realm’.
I could vividly picture Uriel pestering the ‘Scribe of Heaven’.
As long as the agreement between the two groups remained in effect, Uriel probably wouldn’t be able to participate in this game.
In the end, I reached for another straw.
“Great Sage, Heaven’s Equal.”
But the Great Sage, Heaven’s Equal didn’t give much of a response either.
[The constellation, ‘Prisoner of the Golden Headband’, picks his nose while looking at you.]
[The constellation, ‘Prisoner of the Golden Headband’, clicks his tongue at the other industrial complexes’ constellations as though they are pathetic.]
Apparently, that proud monkey king didn’t consider this his stage. Lending his own power to a scenario of this level would presumably wound his pride.
[The constellation, ‘Abyssal Black Flame Dragon’, looks at you with a snicker.]
Jang Hayoung asked, perhaps having heard the message too.
“How about Flame Dragon?”
“No.”
“Why? He’s nicer than you’d think.”

I knew the Abyssal Black Flame Dragon wasn’t as bad as he seemed. But borrowing his power lightly carried too great a risk. And, most importantly, I had another use in mind for the ‘Abyssal Black Flame Dragon’. I sighed.
“No choice, then. Is there only one constellation left······?”
“Who’s that······?”
[The constellation, ‘Bald General of Justice’, grips his bamboo staff as though he has been waiting for this.]
“Jang Hayoung. Send a message to ‘Secretive Plotter’.”
[Several constellations are startled by your choice!]
The constellation, ‘Secretive Plotter’.
The only one of my channel’s four main regulars whose identity I didn’t know.
With even the Great Sage, Heaven’s Equal and the Black Flame Dragon back in the channel, I didn’t understand why this one still hadn’t appeared.
[A tiny number of constellations are frightened by your choice.]
[Several constellations try to dissuade you from your choice!]
I understood their reactions.
I didn’t know for certain who Secretive Plotter was, but there was a strong likelihood that this was one of the ‘Outer Gods’.
And one with enough influence to drive away the ‘Great Old Ones’, at that.
The other constellations were probably deeply conscious of that too.
After tapping at something in the air for a while, Jang Hayoung called to me.
“Kim Dokja. Are you sure you gave me the right modifier?”
“Why?”
“Look at this.”
Jang Hayoung showed me the screen they had been typing into.
The message on the screen read as follows.
[This modifier does not exist in the <Star Stream>.]
Bewildered, I asked Jang Hayoung,
“Are you sure you typed it correctly?”
“Do you think I’m an idiot?”
Jang Hayoung entered ‘Secretive Plotter’ in the recipient constellation field once more.
[This modifier does not exist in the <Star Stream>.]
‘Secretive Plotter’······ was a modifier that didn’t exist?
[The constellation, ‘Prisoner of the Golden Headband’, looks intrigued.]
[The constellation, ‘Abyssal Black Flame Dragon’, becomes curious.]
[The constellation, ‘Master of the Skywalk’, activates a network.]
[Numerous constellations begin making inquiries about ‘Secretive Plotter’.]
I had never imagined this possibility, and for a moment, my mind froze.
[You have 1 minute remaining.]
Some great constellations did indeed have multiple modifiers.
But had anything like this ever happened?
A perfectly functional modifier had disappeared?
“What do we do now?”
Jang Hayoung looked at me anxiously.
There were fewer than 30 seconds left now.
[The constellation, ‘Bald General of Justice’, rises from his seat with a wild cry!]
I looked up at the sky.
It was getting hard to ignore him any longer.
“······Samyeongdang-nim, please help us.”
At my words, lightning flashed in the sky.
Whoooooosh!
[The constellation, ‘Bald General of Justice’, gains probability and summons his incarnation body!]
Watching the incarnation body take shape amid the dazzling rays of light, I thought:
Right now, it might be better to take a somewhat less impressive but trustworthy constellation as a companion than a powerful one I couldn’t control.
At least Samyeongdang was one of the constellations who had supported me when I obtained the ‘Right to Establish a Nebula’.
Rrrrrumble!
Even after the summoning ceremony ended, the light still didn’t fade.
Looking closely, I saw flashes of light gleaming from Samyeongdang’s head.
As I discreetly shaded my eyes with a hand, a voice rang out.
[It has been a long time, Kim Dokja.]
His True Voice carried such formidable internal energy that I couldn’t help marveling.
Even dogs and cats could become constellations if they were lucky.
But that didn’t mean just anyone could become one.
“It has been a long time, Samyeongdang-nim.”
A divine monk (神僧) of towering stature, perhaps three meters tall.
A great bamboo staff (竹杖) planted in the earth like a massive tree.
Samyeongdang, a Historical-grade constellation of the Korean Peninsula, had finally revealed his true appearance.
[You have acquired the helper, ‘Bald General of Justice’.]
[You have recruited all your helpers!]
[All participants have finished recruiting helpers.]
[The game, ‘Mythical Battlefield’, manifests (顯現) in the Demon Realm!]
With the system message, the scenery around us began to change.
Mythical Battlefield.
The defining feature of this game, ‘Mythical Battlefield’, was that it borrowed virtual recreations of places where [Giant Stories] had unfolded throughout history.
―You have entered the great battlefield, <Armageddon>.
―The game begins in 3 minutes.

On one side of the pitch-black sky stood a stairway to heaven, and on the other, the gates of hell lay open. If this were real, <Eden>’s archangels would have come pouring down those stairs, and the <Demon Realm>’s demon kings would have surged out through the gates of hell.
Fortunately, that wouldn’t happen here.
This was only a ‘virtual stage’, after all.
[The constellation, ‘Guardian of Youths and Travel’, frowns at the familiar stage.]
[The demon king, ‘Devil of Lust and Wrath’, reveals hostility toward the ‘Guardian of Youths and Travel’.]
[Numerous constellations and demon kings reveal their antagonism toward one another.]
······I really hoped nothing would happen.
“This is kind of creepy······.”
Jang Hayoung wrapped both arms around their own shoulders and looked around the sky. Eerie sounds occasionally drifted over, whether they were background effects or something else.
I looked at the enormous barrier surrounding us.
That barrier would protect us until the game began.
“Everyone, get a hold of yourselves. Check the positions you chose.”
At my words, the others seemed to regain their composure one by one.
“Who’s the tank?”
[That would be me.]

Samyeongdang was the tank. The Breaking the Sky Sword Master and I were the melee damage dealers, and Jang Hayoung and Osu were the ranged damage dealers. Han Myungoh was the support. And the ‘all-rounder’ was······.
“What about Yoo Joonghyuk?”
“He probably landed somewhere else.”
In ‘Mythical Battlefield’, your starting area depended on where you accepted the summons.
[The helper, ‘Yoo Joonghyuk’, has accepted the summons.]
The message had appeared properly, so Yoo Joonghyuk would be somewhere on this battlefield too.
Jang Hayoung asked,
“This is like that game, Battlefield of Space and Time or whatever, right? I’ve played it before. You win by destroying the enemy base······.”
“Right. But there are some differences.”
Normally, an AOS game ended when you took down the enemy base.
But this game was different.
“What we have to protect is a ‘sentence’, not a ‘base’.”
“A sentence?”
I pointed at the object in Han Myungoh’s hand. It was a small stone tablet shimmering with an array of luminous colors.
“W-what is this?”
“We have to protect that.”
A short ‘sentence’ was written on the tablet, quite literally.
『Heaven’s Messenger (使者), Hell’s Gatekeeper (守門將)』
Horrified, Han Myungoh tried to hand the tablet to me.
I pushed it away with my palm and said,
“You hold on to it for now, Department Head-nim. It’s important, so keep it safe.”
“S-since it’s important, having you hold on to it, Dokja-ssi······!”
“Since it’s important, it’s better for you to hold on to it. The principal participants usually carry the ‘sentences’. We need to catch the enemy team off guard.”
“I-I can’t! I’ve never played a game like this!”
Han Myungoh certainly was rather clueless about games for a department head at a game company.

“······He looked pretty close to invincible.”
“That was because the constellations didn't know much about this game yet.”
Starting with the second match, the stat restrictions would gradually ease.
The constellations who'd underestimated us would begin collecting attributes and skills related to this game, spending vast amounts of coins to close the gap.
Even with ‘Ruler of Amusement’, there was only so much Yoo Joonghyuk could do alone.
After thinking for a moment, I spoke to the others.
“I have an idea.”
“We've agreed to cooperate with the [Bercan Industrial Complex] this match.”
[······Are you telling us to join forces with those scraps of Papyrus?]
“This is no time to be picky.”
A deep sigh escaped Duke Melledon's rhinoceros-like face.
Every constellation on this battlefield had been trampled by a single incarnation.
They'd let their guard down and been struck from behind, been hit by a blade bursting out from beneath their feet.
One constellation had even lost a one-on-one fight.
“We must not let them earn victory points again this time. I'm sure you all understand.”
[Do not worry. We let our guard down last match, but it will not happen this time.]
Manu, the ‘Founder of Humanity’, ground his teeth and raised the Primitive Spear.
[I have now learned enough about this game.]
Indeed, messages had been ringing out furiously in the air for some time.
[The constellation, ‘Founder of Humanity’, has purchased the skill, ‘Special-grade Gaming Talent’!]
[The constellation, ‘Thunder Eating Bird’, has purchased the item, ‘Even a Birdbrain Can Become a Game Master in a Week’!]
The sudden buying frenzy had the dokkaebis grinning from ear to ear.
[Oh my, constellations-nim! You're going this far······]
The constellations found the dokkaebis' behavior obnoxious, but their pride, crushed by a mere incarnation, mattered far more.
[Let's go.]
The moment the game began, the constellations moved in perfect coordination.

The attributes and items had a considerable effect. They now used the terrain to move flawlessly between concealment and cover, and they thoroughly understood how their stigmas and skills worked in this game.
The enemy team's only All-rounder was that one absurd incarnation.
Kill him, and the game would be over.
[There.]
The ‘Thunder Eating Bird’ swept through the air with a thunderous sound, raising a gale. As the wind bent back the brush, the saber's wielder came into view.
It was Yoo Joonghyuk.
“Now!”
At Duke Melledon's signal, four constellations charged at once.
[This will be different from before!]
The Founder of Humanity swung his spear first, followed by King Oedipus's blast of light.
Hissssss!
Unable to dodge in time, Yoo Joonghyuk bled from his forearm.
The General of Vanara's shadow split, seeking openings in Yoo Joonghyuk's defenses. A staff shot out sharply and grazed his side.
Crack!
It had only grazed him, yet there was a sound of flesh bursting.
The constellations could now use up to thirty percent of their full strength.
The damage Yoo Joonghyuk took was on an entirely different level from before.
Boom! Booooom!
Yet Yoo Joonghyuk held up well under the constellations' onslaught.
[······What? Why isn't he dying?]
Sensing something strange, Duke Melledon used a skill to estimate Yoo Joonghyuk's remaining health.
Amazingly, Yoo Joonghyuk still had at least 70 percent of his health left.
“Th-there's something strange about his health. Could he be······!”
That was when the constellations' screams came from behind.
The enemies probably believed without a doubt that Yoo Joonghyuk was the ‘All-rounder’.
“Breaking the Sky Sword Master!”

At my signal, the Breaking the Sky Sword Master launched herself forward. Like a spear of light cleaving through space, she pierced the torso of the ‘Thunder Eating Bird’, which was targeting Yoo Joonghyuk from the air.
Kwaaaaaah―!
As the badly wounded bird thrashed in the air, the Breaking the Sky Sword Master sank in her fangs and relentlessly tore at its torso.
Woooof―!

As soon as our location was exposed, the nearby constellations began charging toward us. Three in total. As a ranged damage dealer, Jang Hayoung had an Agility penalty and would have no chance once close combat began.
But this time, things were a little different.
“Kim Dokja, buy me just 10 seconds.”
“Got it.”
Jang Hayoung took a horse stance and began gathering power, extending the left hand forward and drawing the right fist back inward toward the shoulder.
[Jang Hayoung uses the points earned to unseal a specific skill.]
[The helper, ‘Jang Hayoung’, prepares an ultimate ability!]
In this game, stigmas and skills above a certain level of power were treated as ‘ultimate abilities’.
And ultimate abilities could only be unlocked with points earned through the game.
Jang Hayoung had used the points just earned from an assist.
[The helper, ‘Jang Hayoung’, activates Breaking the Sky Force Punch (破天崩拳) Lv.10!]
Kaboooooooom!

A roar like a cannon blast rang out, and an enormous gust of force poured from Jang Hayoung's fist, tearing space apart. Overwhelming even King Oedipus's blast of light, it sent two of the charging constellations flying.
Breaking the Sky Force Punch.
I'd seen it in ‘Ways of Survival’.
A martial art the Breaking the Sky Sword Saint, who'd walked only the path of the sword, had supposedly created to pass the time.
······If this was what she did to pass the time, I couldn't imagine what her true, full strength would be like.
[The helper, ‘Jang Hayoung’, has killed the helper, ‘Thunder Eating Bird’!]
[The helper, ‘Jang Hayoung’, has incapacitated the helper, ‘General of Vanara’!]
I'd thought taking down even one constellation would count as a success.
Yet one constellation had died, and another had suffered a critical wound.
“I told you I'd been training hard, too, didn't I?”
Despite the smile, Jang Hayoung was clearly pushing too hard.
Even for Jang Hayoung, it would have been difficult to improve this much in such a short time.
Jang Hayoung had probably made a deal with the ‘Unidentifiable Wall’.
[Kill them!]
The enraged constellations charged, unleashing terrifying Status.
Instead of retreating, Jang Hayoung ran toward them.
“Kim Dokja! Go! Stick to the plan!”
Carrying Jang Hayoung away on my back would slow me down.
And this time, I was the one carrying the ‘sentence’.
Not long after I began sprinting toward the canyon, screams rang out behind me.
[The helper, ‘Breaking the Sky Sword Master’, has been killed!]
[The helper, ‘Jang Hayoung’, has been killed!]
······Damn it.
Fortunately, Yoo Joonghyuk seemed to be safe so far.
Whether he was a Tank or an All-rounder, Yoo Joonghyuk was still Yoo Joonghyuk.
By the time I'd reached the bottom of the canyon, dark fog was beginning to roll in around me. Just as I'd calculated. If ‘Fog Generation’ had begun, that ‘monster’ would soon appear here.
That was when I sensed the presence of constellations higher up among the rocks.
[You're quick, Demon King of Salvation.]
This was an unexpected move.
The Melledon side should have been tied up by Yoo Joonghyuk. How were they here already?
The moment I saw the shadows rising above the canyon's rocks, I understood what had happened.
The shadow of an enormous mummy.
And a goddess with a pointed scorpion tail.
They were constellations from the [Bercan] faction whom I hadn't seen in the previous match.
The ‘Last Pharaoh’, Cleopatra, and the ‘Scorpion Goddess’, Serket······
Amazingly, I could also see King Oedipus of the [Melledon] faction among them.
I smiled bitterly.
“······I see. Looks like you've decided to join forces?”
Serket's tail swelled enormously, firing venomous darts at me.
Fwoosh-woosh-woosh!
As I tried to dodge, old bandages scattered by the ‘Last Pharaoh’ coiled around my ankles.
‘Melee damage dealers’ were vulnerable to the rapid fire of ‘ranged damage dealers’. With my movement restricted as well, it was all too clear that I'd die at this rate.
I saw King Oedipus preparing the finishing blow.
I reflexively curled up.
Boooooooom!
A powerful storm of light swept over my body.
I thought I caught the constellations' laughter amid the explosion.
It was unmistakably the laughter of those certain that this blow had killed me.
[The victory points earned in the previous match are converted into points!]
[A specific skill has been unsealed using points!]
I slowly straightened up amid the cloud of dust.
Through my hazy vision, I could see that the smiles had vanished from the constellations' faces.
[The constellation, ‘The One Who Stabbed His Own Eyes’, is shocked!]
[The constellation, ‘Scorpion Goddess’, opens her eyes wide!]
The pure white fur coat wrapped around me had protected me from their powerful combined attack without a single scratch.
[The exclusive skill, ‘Bookmark’, is active!]
It had been a long time since I'd used ‘Bookmark No. 3’.
For quite a while, I'd hesitated to use this bookmark.
Because I'd thought using it would be disrespectful to my dokkaebi.
[Your understanding of this individual is very high, strengthening the skill's stats!]
[The exclusive skill, ‘Beast King’s Sensitivity Lv.10(+1)’, is active!]
I could feel Biyoo's warmth as she lay curled up tight inside my clothes.
Bookmark No. 3, Beast Master Shin Yoosung.
Wrapped in pure white fur, I looked at the constellations above the canyon.
[The participant, ‘Demon King of Salvation’, receives adjustments from his position effect.]
I didn't have the attack power of ‘Yoo Joonghyuk’.
Nor could I learn things as quickly as ‘Jang Hayoung’.
But there was something I did better than them, too.
“Sorry, but I'm the ‘All-rounder’ in this game.”
The ‘Demon King Selection’ would end in the second match.
